string.name: status_time_left_hours_minutes
string.comment: Time left before a sensor or pod stops, used when less than 10 hours are left. h=hours, m=minutes. %1$d=hours, %2$02d=minutes. Example: 9h05m

string.name: status_time_left_minutes
string.comment: Time left before a sensor or pod stops, used when less than 1 hour is left. m=minutes. %1$d=minutes. Example: 45m

string.name: status_overdue
string.comment: Time since a sensor, cannula or battery should have been changed. %1$s=time, like 3h or 2d5h. The minus means it is past the deadline. Example: -3h
